projectTitle: 51Degrees Device Detection, IP Intelligence, Human Confidence, and Identifiers for C and C++
description: The C and C++ engine behind every 51Degrees on-premise package. Device Detection is a User-Agent and Client Hints parser that finds the device, browser, operating system, and crawlers, an alternative to UAParser.js, DeviceAtlas, and WURFL. IP Intelligence gives the network, ASN, and registered country, and IP geolocation with the Enterprise data file, an alternative to MaxMind and IPinfo. Human Confidence and Identifiers, such as the 51Did, come through the 51Degrees cloud service.
